original_turns.speaker: Driver
original_turns.text: Good evening. My name is Alex. I am your driver. Are you Ms Green?

original_turns.speaker: Passenger
original_turns.text: Yes, I am. Good evening. Thank you for waiting. It took a little longer to collect my luggage.

original_turns.speaker: Driver
original_turns.text: You are welcome. Your booking is for Riverside Hotel, is that right?

original_turns.speaker: Passenger
original_turns.text: Yes, that is right. I have 3 bags. Could you help me with the largest one, please?

original_turns.speaker: Driver
original_turns.text: Of course. Your car is just outside. Please keep your passport and any medicine with you.

original_turns.speaker: Passenger
original_turns.text: Thank you. I appreciate your help. I will keep my small bag with me.
